integrity: The theorem is proved directly by an induction on the refinement waves along the path; the included verifier independently checks the formula and the full intermediate partitions over a broad finite range.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary one-dimensional color refinement from the uniform coloring is treated.
No claim is made about higher-dimensional Weisfeiler--Leman refinement, arbitrary initial colorings, or logical defining depth.
The finite computation is a consistency check and does not replace the general proof.
title: Exact color-refinement depth of lollipop graphs
